# Decrypt the XOR-encoded flag
# The algorithm: input[i] ^ key = encrypted[i], then key += input[i]
# To reverse: input[i] = encrypted[i] ^ key, then key += input[i]

    0x3d, 0x8d, 0x4c, 0x09, 0xee, 0x73, 0x0a, 0x9c,
    0x2e, 0xab, 0x40, 0xd5, 0x46, 0x1a, 0xbf, 0x5e,
